metas.name: Bramayugam
metas.description: A folk singer in 17th-century Kerala discovers a mansion. Inside, he encounters an enigmatic cook and a powerful master, setting in motion a chain of events that changes his life.

metas.name: Secret of Kalinga
metas.description: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.

metas.name: Sumathi Valavu
metas.description: A haunted curve in 1990s Kerala, named after Sumathis tragic death, draws various people into supernatural encounters. As they experience strange events, the mystery of Sumathi and the roads dark history begins to unfold.

metas.name: Aroopi
metas.description: A vengeful Yakshini, once sealed inside a doll at the Aryanattu estate, is accidentally unleashed by two thieves. When a brutal murder draws Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the lineage, back to his ancestral home, he must confront an ancient curse and the dark secrets surrounding his family's past.

metas.name: Manichitrathazhu
metas.description: A young couple, Ganga and Nakulan, arrives at the ancestral home called Madampalli of the latter. Hailing from a family that follows tradition and superstitions, Nakulan's uncle Thampi objects to the couple's idea of moving into the allegedly haunted mansion, which Nakulan ignores. The couple moves in anyway following which seemingly supernatural events begin to happen.

metas.name: Gu
metas.description: Gu follows the fearless eight-year-old Minna on her first visit to her dads ancestral home where she becomes enthralled by the legend of Gulikan, a spectral presence rumored to appear anytime, day or night.  When her cousin Paru falls under the grip of an evil entity, Minna and her cousins embark on a courageous mission to banish the malevolent force

metas.name: Prakambanam
metas.description: A group of students' lives are thrown into chaos after one of them is possessed by the spirit of an elderly woman.

metas.name: Diés Iraé
metas.description: Rohan's affluent lifestyle spirals out of control as he becomes convinced there is a supernatural entity in his home. As he starts to uncover the mystery, he is drawn into unexpected worlds and alliances, along with the horrors that lie ahead.

metas.name: Karakkam
metas.description: A drunken New Year's prank goes horribly wrong when two young men remove sacred crosses from graves. Five restless ghosts emerge to haunt their every move, driving them to seek redemption and release.

metas.name: Romancham
metas.description: Set in 2007, in the outskirts of Bengaluru, A game of Ouija board goes hilariously wrong when seven bachelors unexpectedly invite a spirit and try to make the best out of the situation.

metas.name: Kalpana House
metas.description: A young man keeps seeing coffins come in and out of the new neighbors house. He sees that women who go into that house simply disappear. He contacts the police but to no avail.

metas.name: Vadakkan
metas.description: A paranormal investigator based in Helsinki ventures to Kerala to probe a series of mysterious deaths during a reality TV show shoot and confronts an unspeakable entity from a Dravidian cult practice, lurking on a mysterious island.

metas.name: Granny
metas.description: Rony, a home nurse movies into a remote house to take care of a strange old woman only know an 'Granny'. His sanity starts slipping as her behavior turns increasingly eccentric.

metas.name: Kanimangalam Kovilakam
metas.description: A haunted cemetery draws attention away from the real supernatural force lurking in a nearby hostel, where three students become entangled with an unexplained energy.

metas.name: Incident
metas.description: A police inspector gets stuck deep inside a forest with a wounded leg but later realizes that he's part of a much bigger conspiracy.

metas.name: Bhoothakaalam
metas.description: Following the death of a family member, a mother and son experience mysterious events which distort their sense of reality and make them question their sanity.

metas.name: Karimpoocha
metas.description: Karimpoocha is a 1981 Indian Malayalam film directed and produced by Baby. The film stars Jagathy Sreekumar, Jose Prakash, Ratheesh and Meena in lead roles. The music of the film was composed by KJ Joy.

metas.name: Sreekrishna Parunthu
metas.description: Kumaran Thampi, a wizard, is not able to keep his vow of celibacy. This keeps getting him into many troubles, most of which are lethal.

metas.name: Praana
metas.description: A young woman decides to lead a solitary life in an old mansion, where she soon realizes that the nature surrounding her has other plans for her.

metas.name: Missing Girl
metas.description: To create a ghost story to prevent his old bungalow from being sold, they begin formulating an action plan. What will they do when they find out that the bungalow is actually haunted?

metas.name: Ezra
metas.description: An urban couple Ranjan Mathew and Priya have just moved to Kochi when powers of the supernatural start to take over their lives. How they tide over the forces forms the story.​

metas.name: Bhargavi Nilayam
metas.description: A novelist comes to haunted house and starts writing story on the ghost named Bhargavi. The novelist understands the cruel death of Bhargavi and her lover.

metas.name: Aakasha Ganga
metas.description: The Maanikesseri family burn their maid Ganga alive after she falls in love with one of the members. Later, she returns as a spirit to take revenge against the perpetrators.

metas.name: Hi I'm Tony
metas.description: "Hi, I am Tony" is a psycho thriller based on happenings in a day in Bangalore.Sameer (Asif Ali)and Tina (Mia) elopes to Bangalore after their days of love.They live in a flat owned by Achayan (Biju Menon). Tony (Lal)comes to their flat after he had an encounter with them.

metas.name: Manthrikan
metas.description: Exorcist Mukundan meets and falls in love with Malu, a girl who has lost her memory. A few years later, he arrives at a palatial house for an exorcism and bumps into Malu who fails to recognise him.

metas.name: Vismayathumbathu
metas.description: Sreekumar comes across a girl while visiting his childhood friend, Govindan Kutty. However, he later realises that she is the spirit of a student who disappeared a while ago.

metas.name: Phoenix
metas.description: John and his family relocate to a far away island village with hopes of rebuilding their lives. But destiny has other plans for them as a series of horrifying events begin to unfold.

metas.name: Dracula 2012
metas.description: Dracula 2012 is a 2013 Indian 3-D horror film directed by Vinayan, starring Sudheer Sukumaran, Prabhu, Monal Gajjar, Nassar, Shraddha Das and Thilakan. The film was shot in the Malayalam, Telugu, and Tamil languages simultaneously, with additional scenes and songs featuring Tamil and Telugu actors

metas.name: Yakshiyum Njanum
metas.description: Unaware of her reality, Syam falls in love with Aathira, a ghost who wants to avenge her and her lover's deaths by killing a minister. However, when Syam discovers the truth, he decides to help her.
